text: Unlike other societal transformations that require drawn out public debate, decentralization proceeds quietly, incrementally, and iteratively as a default solution because it builds on the existing centralized network infrastructure.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Preface to (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782191
abstract: By contrast, the decentralization of business and society is mostly a quiet occurrence without much media attention that appears as a default solution based on the existing centralized network infrastructure.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: compared with contested changes such as globalization
